searchText: Not sure if this is the right place to be posting but I was curious about reorgs on the beacon chain and wrote up this investigation: https://www.samlewis.me/2022/03/beacon-chain-reorgs/ . One thing that is still puzzling me is why the block in the second reorg I investigated (https://www.samlewis.me/2022/03/beacon-chain-reorgs/#slot-3340347) was reorged. As I describe in the write up, if I understand the fork choice rules, it seems like it shouldn't have been reorged and the network should have included it in the main chain. Anyone have any ideas on what I might be missing? time_from_last_slot is it from the previous or the current slot, namely 46 is 10 seconds or 22 seconds late? Okay who took out Vitalik's master node. PoS participation dropped around 17:30 UTC. Cause unknown afaik, and may have recovered. It's the delta time from when the previous block was received, which is probably not the most useful way of slicing the data. I went back and computed the time delay between the block arriving to me and the start of the slot for those two blocks.. For 3340346: `slot_time=1646908175000` and `arrival_time=1646908187984` so it arrived 12984ms after the start of the slot. For 3340347: `slot_time=1646908187000` and `arrival_time=1646908188541` so it arrived 1541ms after the start of the slot. Still unsure why the network chose 3340346 instead of 3340347, when 3340346 appears (at least to me) to have arrived super late.
